Splitify for Android (Android 8.0 / API 26 or later). Installs as an update over any earlier version; your data stays in your Google account.

## What's new

**Link a payment to items (optional)**
- When marking a payment as paid, tick which of your shares it covers, or use **Select all**.
- The remaining amount updates as you tick items; items that would go over the amount paid can't be selected.
- Each item shows its date and time, so items with the same name are easy to tell apart.
- The receiver sees the linked items when confirming the payment.

**Individual Expenses**
- Linked amounts appear as **Paid** on each covered item, with who it was paid to and when. Any unlinked part stays as a separate settlement line.
- Every item now shows its date and time.

## Install
Download **Splitify-v1.7.0.apk** below and open it on your Android device.
